description: A3 task 4 (F2): timed Pause, Resume and Finish early on Round 7’s TimedWorkoutFlow, kept across reloads (REQ-006; C17, C18; JOURNEY-006, completion owner). check-01 proves the wiring on the real /workout route and the real components: the build’s nine TASK-006 cases rewritten to Round 7’s controls (Start, then a secondary Pause beside the format’s primary Finish or Finish early from finishLabel, Resume in Pause’s place, the lead control one element so focus is kept, the slot after the work and before coaching and the long ladder’s top exception, section Finish distinct from Finish workout, a paused section back paused after close and reopen, the gallery ladder-4 and ladder-12 states); TASK-104’s own cases (every format’s paused clock restored with the same time left from one pause stamp in its own record, the ladder’s inside its durable attempt through pauseLadderAttempt/resumeLadderAttempt, an older For Time-kept ladder clock adopted, Undo finish returning focus to the lead control, the EMOM’s PAUSED and FINISHED EARLY and ‘Finished early, in minute N of M’ with nothing counted, the For Time Finish label following the cap, the gallery emom/amrap/for_time states over memory only); the carried pause arithmetic (src/state/timed-lifecycle.test.ts); and the carried lifecycle cases of the shipped AMRAP, EMOM and For Time renderers. parity is the look check: /workout’s timed card beside each accepted gallery state (bec4454: emom, amrap, for_time, ladder-4, ladder-12) with matched data at 320 and 390 px, driven alike on the browser clock through ready, running, paused, the Log results dialog and the ended card, compared in words and in layout (every element’s box within 2 px); every visible difference must be labelled with the criterion that intends it, and each case writes its receipt to evidence/refinement/task-104/parity/ and its captures to the evidence store. The route-level journey is e2e/refinement/task-006.spec.ts (TASK-006 check-02, rewritten for Round 7), run under TASK-006’s manifest.

check-01.command: node scripts/refinement/run-required-check.mjs --task TASK-104 --check check-01 -- npx vitest run src/ui/timed-workout-flow.test.tsx src/state/timed-lifecycle.test.ts src/ui/amrap-block.test.tsx src/ui/emom-block.test.tsx src/ui/for-time-block.test.tsx --passWithNoTests=false
